image_description: A composite image displaying multiple views of a black handheld PDA (Personal Digital Assistant) or early smartphone. The main view shows the device held in a human hand, featuring a touchscreen, physical navigation buttons below the screen, and an external antenna. Background elements include a line drawing of the device with a stylus, a technical schematic of the back panel, and a cutaway view showing internal battery/components.

The internal components shown in the cutaway view are nonsensical and geometrically inconsistent, appearing as melted or generic shapes rather than realistic circuit boards or batteries.
The stylus floats in mid-air with ambiguous shadowing, lacking a clear connection to the device or a surface, creating a slight spatial grounding issue.
